Convert a data frame to the standard news schema

Source: R/read.R
as_news.Rd

Maps the columns of any news data frame to the standard schema used by every other function: doc_id (chr), date (Date), source (chr), title (chr), text (chr) and keyword (chr, comma-separated). Columns that are not mapped are kept after the standard ones.

Usage

as_news(
  df,
  text = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  date = NULL,
  source = NULL,
  keyword = NULL,
  id = NULL,
  keyword_sep = ",",
  dedup = FALSE,
  quiet = FALSE
)

Arguments

df

A data frame of news articles, one row per article.

text, title, date, source, keyword, id

Column names in df, NULL to detect, or NA to leave empty. Without an id column, row numbers are used.

keyword_sep

Separator used in the keyword column; it is converted to commas. A list column of keywords is also accepted.

dedup

If TRUE, drop repeated articles: rows with the same id, or the same title, date and source (or text, when there are no titles).

quiet

If TRUE, do not report detected columns. A warning is still raised when title, date or source cannot be detected; pass NA for a field to leave it empty on purpose.

Value

A tibble in the standard news schema.

Details

Columns left as NULL are detected by name, case-insensitively, from a list of common names: BigKinds' Korean headers, title/headline, text/body/content/description, date/pubDate/published, source/press/media, id/guid and others. The chosen mapping is reported in a message. A column you name must exist; NA skips a field. At least one of text and keyword is required.

Dates are parsed element by element from YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY.MM.DD, YYYY/MM/DD, YYYYMMDD, Korean YYYY년 M월 D일 and RFC 822 (Mon, 02 Jan 2024 13:05:00 +0900, as in RSS) forms, with or without a time; the calendar date as written is kept. Values that cannot be parsed become NA with a warning.

Examples

df <- data.frame(
  headline = c("first", "second", "second"),
  body = c("first article", "second article", "second article"),
  published = c("2024.01.01", "2024\ub144 1\uc6d4 2\uc77c", "2024\ub144 1\uc6d4 2\uc77c"),
  media = "A\uc77c\ubcf4"
)
as_news(df, dedup = TRUE)
#> Detected columns: date <- `published`, source <- `media`, title <- `headline`, text <- `body`
#> # A tibble: 2 × 6
#>   doc_id date       source title  text           keyword
#>   <chr>  <date>     <chr>  <chr>  <chr>          <chr>  
#> 1 1      2024-01-01 A일보  first  first article  NA     
#> 2 2      2024-01-02 A일보  second second article NA     
as_news(df, text = "body", title = NA, quiet = TRUE)
#> # A tibble: 3 × 7
#>   doc_id date       source title text           keyword headline
#>   <chr>  <date>     <chr>  <chr> <chr>          <chr>   <chr>   
#> 1 1      2024-01-01 A일보  NA    first article  NA      first   
#> 2 2      2024-01-02 A일보  NA    second article NA      second  
#> 3 3      2024-01-02 A일보  NA    second article NA      second  

as_news(president_lee_2026_08)
#> Detected columns: doc_id <- `뉴스 식별자`, date <- `일자`, source <- `언론사`, title <- `제목`, keyword <- `키워드`
